"Consider the augmented matrix

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -1 \\ -2 & -3 & -2 & -2 \\ -1 & -2 & -4 & -5\end{array}\right].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form."] [:db/add "49bb4710-b92e-54c7-b99c-2722f73c1b5c" :question/worked-solution "The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -1 \\ -2 & -3 & -2 & -2 \\ -1 & -2 & -4 & -5\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ -1 & -2 & -4 & -5\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot."] [:db/add "49bb4710-b92e-54c7-b99c-2722f73c1b5c" :question/difficulty
